itemized.notes: Sam Granato, County Council District 4, June 19 2012 interim AMENDMENT. Structure: PDF p3 = Itemized Contributions form page ('* See Attached *', empty boxes), p4-p5 = the contributions spreadsheet attachment (35 rows + printed TOTAL), p6 = Itemized Expenditures form page ('* See Attached *'), p7 = the expenditures spreadsheet attachment (21 rows + printed TOTALS). BOTH attachments are LANDSCAPE and were rotated 90 degrees clockwise to read; their pct: geometry is converted BACK to the portrait orientation poppler renders, so each row is a narrow VERTICAL strip - correct, not a bug. Row bands were measured by text-band detection. NO REDACTION on the attachments: they have no street-address column at all (City / State / Zip only), so donor_city/donor_state come straight from the sheet - unlike this filer's April interim, whose form-page address column was black-barred. ALL 21 EXPENDITURE DATES ARE LEFT BLANK: the attachment's Date column is truncated by its column width ('4/6/201', '4/10/20'), so no year is fully printed; confirmed at 500dpi. Per the contract a partially printed year is not a parseable date, and the year is NOT filled in from the report period. The verbatim truncated string is kept in each row note. Contribution dates are NOT truncated and are transcribed. Two source oddities kept verbatim: the Shawn Ledingham row prints city 'LosAngeles' and zip 90034 but State 'UT'; the Sunset Manufacturing expenditure prints '1,199.39' with no dollar sign while every other row has one.
